column11: derived: Merck generated $39,599mm of free cash flow on $189,294mm of revenue over 2023, 2024 and 2025, a 20.92% margin, against the 29.5% its cost of sales, SG&A and R&D leave. Solved so the modelled book reproduces that margin rather than assumed from one line's cost structure: the alliance rows carry no cost of sales and Animal Health carries its own, so a ratio taken off a single product does not reconcile the company. The window barely matters here, unlike Pfizer: the same aggregate is 21.9% over five years and 21.3% over every year on file. Restated before interest: MRK paid $3,700mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 1.95% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 12.10% to 10.14%. Restated at replacement capex: MRK spent $11,347mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $6,977mm of plant depreciation, 2.31% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge falls from 10.14% to 7.48%. Restated without one-off cash: MRK's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried $8,300mm of deal payments in operating cash flow, capital allocation whose assets the book values separately; $572mm of legal settlements; $1,200mm of US transition tax (2025 instalment 1,200mm). None recurs, so the charge falls from 7.48% to 2.06%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 MRK's cash flow statement shows receivables up $2,482mm, inventories up $2,831mm, payables down $88mm, a working capital build of $5,401mm, 2.85% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 2.06% to -1.23%. Rebuilt on the book's own ratios on 0.3610 of the revenue they are struck on, against 0.3746 the filings leave as cash over 2023 to 2025 (free cash flow before interest, at replacement capex, without one-off cash and without working capital build), so the charge is -1.3576%.

column11: judgement: MK-2214-004 (NCT07033494) is recruiting with primary completion estimated 2029-04-30 (ClinicalTrials.gov, updated 2026-08-26) and no Phase 3 is registered, so a Phase 3 starts late in 2029 at the earliest. Kisunla went from its Phase 3 start (TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2, NCT04437511, 2020-06-19) to approval on 2024-07-02 (openFDA BLA761248, original) and a first full year in 2025, 4.53 years; Leqembi from Clarity AD (NCT03887455, 2019-03-27) to approval on 2023-01-06 (openFDA BLA761269, original) and 2024, 4.77 years. Late 2029 plus 4.5 to 4.8 years reaches spring to summer 2034, so the first full year on sale is 2035

Leqembi (J0174): 961 in 2023 and 7,907 in 2024 (Medicare Part B Spending by Drug, dataset 76a714ad-3a2c-43ac-b76d-9dadf8f7d890) and 14,029 in 2025 (quarterly file bf6a5b3b-31ee-4abb-b1ad-2607a1e7510a, row '2025 (Q1-Q4)'). Kisunla (J0175): 1,299 in 2024 (dataset 76a714ad) and 9,993 in 2025 (quarterly file), all queried 2026-09-28. At this seed's stopping of 0.521739, 47.83% of a year's patients carry into the next, so 2025 new starts are 14,029 - 7,907 x 0.4783 = 10,247 and 9,993 - 1,299 x 0.4783 = 9,372, 19,619 together. In the engine's terms a year's eligible pool is the carried pool plus the inflow, which in the first year is 2,197,800 + 270,270 = 2,468,070, so the class started 0.7949% of it in 2025. MULTIPLE 0.5, A JUDGEMENT: 0.5 x 0.7949% = 0.3975%, the multiple BMS-986446 takes, about 9,810 US starts a year on that pool
column12: the 0.5 is a judgement and the most arguable figure here. For more: pS413 tau is a different target from the N-terminal epitopes that failed, the antibody is half-life extended, and Fast Track. Against: no efficacy data exist and the Phase 2 primary outcome is tau PET; N-terminal anti-tau antibodies (gosuranemab, semorinemab, tilavonemab) failed; a monthly infusion on top of anti-amyloid therapy; a launch around 2035 behind BMS-986446 (2033 in this book), trontinemab and subcutaneous antibodies. The pool grows by the inflow with no exit, as trontinemab's and BMS-986446's do, so the same share gives more starts in later years
